title.value: Rapidly Inferring Personalized Neurostimulation Parameters with Meta-Learning: A Case Study of Individualized Fiber Recruitment in Vagus Nerve Stimulation
title.justification: The title clearly identifies the focus of the paper on using meta-learning to infer personalized neurostimulation parameters, particularly for fiber recruitment in vagus nerve stimulation.
title.quote: Rapidly Inferring Personalized Neurostimulation Parameters with Meta-Learning: A Case Study of Individualized Fiber Recruitment in Vagus Nerve Stimulation

extractions.description: This paper presents a meta-learning framework to optimize neurostimulation parameters for individual patients, demonstrated through vagus nerve stimulation. The approach focuses on personalizing neurostimulation by efficiently learning from existing data to enhance treatment efficacy and safety. The meta-learning framework allows quick adaptation to individual physiological responses with minimal data required.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The paper primarily addresses personalized medical treatment optimization through meta-learning techniques, with no direct links to climate or ecological sustainable development.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: Objective. Neurostimulation is emerging as treatment for several diseases of the brain and peripheral organs. Due to variability arising from placement of stimulation devices, underlying neuroanatomy and physiological responses to stimulation, it is essential that neurostimulation protocols are personalized to maximize efficacy and safety.
